summary.text: Steve Rawlings is a Republican member of the Kentucky Senate representing District 11, with House service from 2023 to 2024 and Senate service since 2025. The legislature's profile lists Rawlings as co-chair of the Budget Review Subcommittee on Education.

paragraphs.text: According to the legislature's profile, Steve Rawlings is an attorney with a J.D.
The profile also lists a board seat with USA Shooting and an advisory board role with the Merit Theatre Company.
